newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway premier to announce change in cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Norway premier to announce change in cabinet.

text.p: Norwegian Prime Minister Thorbjoern Jagland will announce a change in his cabinet line-up at a news conference at 12.15 p.m. (1115gmt) on Tuesday, an official statement said.
Since Jagland's government took office in October, two ministers have quit in separate scandals. They were National Planning Minister Terje Roed Larsen and Energy Minister Grete Faremo.
